name: 32738 · Deltona, FL
findings: ZIP 32738 (Deltona) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32738 (Deltona) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
